events.title: Kindest Member on HF?
events.description: - by Only on HackForums could a thread about kindness turn into a full-blown debate. This wholesome discussion has already racked up 46+ replies as members nominate - and sometimes jokingly argue - over who deserves the title of HF's kindest soul. Another feel-good moment on the forum that reminds us how awesome the HF community really is.

events.title: HF - Related Content & AI Curated Content
events.description: - by A proposal to evolve HackForums into a smarter, AI-powered content network has revealed that something has already been quietly built. The idea? Use LLMs to generate summaries, link related threads and replies, surface timeless content, and boost discoverability across both forums and blogs.
